name: Blind Justice
source:
With little fanfare, you find yourself in an unfamiliar place, accompanied by an unfamiliar voice, and an unfamiliar man. Unsure if you're stuck in a dream you simply can't wake up from, you decide to do the next best thing:

Play along. 

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/blind-justice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
悄无声息地，你发现自己身处一个陌生的地方，伴随着陌生的声音，陌生的男人。不确定自己是否陷入了无法醒来的梦中，你决定做下一个最好的事情：

一起玩。

[来自[url=https://himebee.itch.io/blind-justice]itch.io[/url]]
